desc:
Apparently, her height is at about the same range as Marisa. 🤔 But you know, it makes more sense now what prompted Toyohime to adopt the other Reisen – they're at about the same height, among other similarities. Hell, when she first arrived at Eientei, Reisen might have had that same bob haircut and possibly hair color.

So for Toyohime, the current Reisen looks a lot like the previous one.
